svg.text: Processes (circles) and data stores (open rectangles = MongoDB collections). Dashed lines are read-only flows for reporting.

Every organisation-owned store (D1, D3–D8) is filtered by organisationId on every query (tenantScoped plugin). D2, D9 and D10 are platform-level. Employee numbers (EMP0001…) come from a small counters collection, not shown.
Sources: server/routes, server/controllers, server/services, server/models (inspected 17 October 2026).
